name: The Hijra: Muhammad's Migration to Medina
summary: Muhammad and his followers migrate from Mecca to Medina (Yathrib), where he is invited to arbitrate tribal disputes. He creates the Constitution of Medina, a remarkable document establishing a multi-religious community under Islamic governance. The Islamic calendar begins from this date. Muhammad rapidly consolidates political and military authority over the Arabian peninsula.

_quarry.structural_significance: Transforms Islam from a spiritual movement to a political community; the Constitution of Medina creates the model of the Islamic state combining religious, military, and civil governance.
